P01.rationale: There are no human portraits on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract layout.

P05.rationale: The numbered sections do not contain client portraits or named case study subjects as requested by the rubric.

P07.rationale: A press/logo wall is present at the bottom of the list section citing BCG and KPMG to provide social proof.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements in the form of giant ghost numerals (1, 2, 3) acting as anchors for the content blocks.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are present at the bottom with specific percentages and labels that bind numbers to business metrics like efficiency and cost reduction.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout where text blocks fill the vertical space without large gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture is present in the form of a subtle paper grain effect that adds atmosphere to the sheet.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page, so this criterion does not apply.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups are shown; the design relies purely on typographic hierarchy and layout.

N07.rationale: The imagery is non-existent as this is a text-heavy editorial page, so it does not suffer from generic stock visuals.

N08.rationale: There are minimal dead whitespace areas, specifically the small gaps between the numbered list items and the footer data section.

N10.rationale: Text is not sitting on busy photos; it sits cleanly on a textured background or within distinct layout blocks.
